We rented a 26-seater Traveller from Mitali Travels, and unfortunately, the experience was highly disappointing. The vehicle was in poor condition, and the AC was not working properly, which made the journey uncomfortable.

The most concerning issue was with the driver, Mr. Pappu. His behavior was extremely unprofessional and disrespectful. He lacked basic manners while speaking to clients and even used offensive language during dinner time. He himself claimed that the owners of Mitali Travels blindly trust him, which, if true, is deeply concerning as such behavior can seriously damage the reputation of the company.

A good driver can make a trip memorable, but an unprofessional one can ruin the entire experience. In our case, Mr. Pappu certainly did the latter.

We strongly recommend confirming the name and behavior of the assigned driver before finalizing any booking with Mitali Travels. If Mr. Pappu is the driver, we suggest reconsidering your decision to avoid a spoiled trip.
